overview: A single-service architecture exposing a Go-based REST API for managing todo items. The service handles list/create/delete operations over HTTP/JSON, persists data to a JSON file on a mounted volume, and uses in-process mutex synchronization for concurrent safety.
requirements: Todos have system-generated unique id, title (1-255 chars), completed boolean, and created_at timestamp
GET /todos returns 200 with JSON array (empty array when none)
POST /todos validates title and returns 201 with full todo; 400 on invalid input or malformed JSON
DELETE /todos/{id} returns 204 on success, 404 when not found
All errors return JSON {message} with appropriate HTTP status codes (400, 404, 500)
Data persists across restarts via file storage
Concurrent requests are safe via mutex synchronization
Each request is logged with method, path, status
All responses use JSON UTF-8; endpoints respond <500ms; supports ≥50 concurrent requests

components.name: todo-api
components.openAPISpec:
openapi: 3.0.3
info:
  title: Todo REST API
  version: 1.0.0
  description: Lightweight backend for managing todo items.
servers:
  - url: http://localhost:9090
paths:
  /health:
    get:
      summary: Health check
      responses:
        '200':
          description: OK
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  status: { type: string }
  /todos:
    get:
      summary: List all todos
      responses:
        '200':
          description: List of todos
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: array
                items: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/Todo' }
    post:
      summary: Create a new todo
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/CreateTodoRequest' }
      responses:
        '201':
          description: Created
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/Todo' }
        '400':
          description: Bad request
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/Error' }
  /todos/{id}:
    delete:
      summary: Delete a todo by id
      parameters:
        - name: id
          in: path
          required: true
          schema: { type: string }
      responses:
        '204':
          description: Deleted
        '404':
          description: Not found
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/Error' }
components:
  schemas:
    Todo:
      type: object
      properties:
        id: { type: string }
        title: { type: string }
        completed: { type: boolean }
        created_at: { type: string, format: date-time }
      required: [id, title, completed, created_at]
    CreateTodoRequest:
      type: object
      properties:
        title: { type: string, maxLength: 255 }
        completed: { type: boolean }
      required: [title]
    Error:
      type: object
      properties:
        message: { type: string }
      required: [message]
components.componentAgentInstructions:
Implement a Go HTTP service using net/http listening on port 9090.

Endpoints:
- GET /health → 200 {"status":"ok"}
- GET /todos → 200 JSON array of todos (empty array [] if none, never null)
- POST /todos → accept JSON {title, completed?}; validate title is present, non-empty after trim, ≤255 chars; default completed=false; generate UUID id; set created_at to time.Now().UTC() in RFC3339; return 201 with full todo. Return 400 with {"message":"..."} on malformed JSON, missing/empty/too-long title.
- DELETE /todos/{id} → 204 on success; 404 with {"message":"todo not found"} if id missing.

Persistence: Use a JSON file at /data/todos.json (configurable via DATA_FILE env, default /data/todos.json). On startup, create the directory if missing and load existing todos; if file missing, start with empty list. On each mutation, write atomically (write to temp file then rename). Protect in-memory state and file I/O with a sync.RWMutex to ensure concurrent safety.

Middleware: Log every request as 'METHOD PATH STATUS DURATION'. Recover from panics and return 500 with {"message":"internal server error"}. All responses Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8.

Use google/uuid for IDs. Use a simple mux (http.ServeMux with manual path parsing for /todos/{id}). Provide a Dockerfile (multi-stage golang:1.22 → distroless/static) exposing 9090 and declaring VOLUME /data.
